_doc: Every bash test of the repository (tests/*.sh and tools/**/test_*.sh) is in exactly one list (test_devtools.py checks).
auto: run by tools/dev/test.sh when the plan selects it (and by --full). `needs`: root, gcc14 (the shipped hooks are
rebuilt with GCC 14), lab (the firmware lab).
manual: Engine sandboxes, scripts that take the heavy lock themselves, and helpers of another script. test.sh never
runs them; when a change selects one, the plan and the result name it with its command, and the lane runs it as its
header says (`enginex-run sandbox|exclusive`, or bare for the self-locking ones).

tests/test_rootfs_overlay.sh.why: release checklist section 2; rebuilds both hooks and compares them with the shipped .so

tools/dev/test_integrate.sh.why: the merge train's own test (fake remote)

tools/ui-mod/test_fx_selector.sh.why: native DSP tests with ASan and TSan, armhf golden tests

tools/ui-mod/test_rekordbox_unwind.sh.why: builds the hook with build.sh and drives test_rekordbox_unwind.c against it

tests/test_backend.sh.why: deployment tests in a private mount namespace

tests/test_backend_private_flag.sh.why: test_backend.sh refuses its re-exec flag (in a throwaway namespace)

tests/test_boot_safety.sh.why: boot state machine with fake Engine and systemd

tests/test_issue311_firstboot.sh.why: #311 first-boot restarts with the boot guard

tests/test_tier2_arch_guard.sh.why: sim/qengine/tier2.sh refuses ARM hosts without side effects

tools/az01-packer/test_gen2_systemd_acti.why: starts real systemd units in a transient scope

tools/az01-packer/test_data_full_sandbox.how: bash tools/az01-packer/test_data_full_sandbox.sh (bare: it takes the heavy lock itself)

tools/az01-packer/test_mixstream_collect.how: after mixstream-sandbox.sh, as its header says
